_comment: What JARVIS's voice skills can see. Read by computer/voice/skills.py. Copy to config/jarvis_sources.json (the installer does) and edit: your name, your city, your news feeds and the project folders JARVIS should know about. Paths may start with ~. A project's 'name_filter' limits it to files whose name contains that text; 'aliases' = how speech recognition tends to hear the name; 'about' = short background JARVIS gets whenever that project comes up. News feeds' 'lang': only 'en' headlines are read aloud (Piper speaks English).

projects.name: My project
projects.about: One sentence about what this project is and what you're focusing on.
